title: Automatic Enrolment Retirement Savings System Act 2024
verified_how: Act number found in the eISB 2024 listing. Enacted page title matches. Directory entry commencement: ss. 1-46 on 31 Mar 2025 (S.I. No. 500 of 2024); ss. 47-48 and 66 on 30 Sep 2025; ss. 49-65 and 67-77 on 1 Jan 2026 (as amended by S.I. No. 439 of 2025).
notes: The auto-enrolment ('My Future Fund') pension scheme. Provisions were commenced in stages. The directory shows the listed provisions commenced by 1 Jan 2026.
